question: Does the Slack owner accept the delivery-pipeline split after reviewing a current-head real Slack transcript or equivalent redacted runtime proof?
rationale: The patch is intentionally behavior-neutral but moves transport-ordering and fallback responsibilities across several modules; automated tests cannot fully establish the external Slack delivery contract.

options.title: Request live delivery proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted Slack run showing streaming or progress updates followed by the final reply on the current head before merging.

options.title: Accept test-backed refactor risk
options.body: Merge based on the existing focused tests and gates if the Slack owner is comfortable accepting the remaining integration risk.

recommendation.title: Request live delivery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted Slack run showing streaming or progress updates followed by the final reply on the current head before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available recent contributor for the dispatch split and its validation context.
